preconditions.state: User is logged in as a member of UAM Users; At least one Organization with an associated Team exists; The team has an assigned manager

steps: Navigate to the User Access Management console
Select the organization whose team the user wants to join
On the 'Assiged Teams' screen, select the team to request access to
Submit the team selection to create the access request
expectedResults: The console loads with the organizations/teams views
The organization's teams are listed under 'Select Teams to join'
The chosen team is selected; the 'Select The Team' button becomes enabled
The request is created and the user returns to the request tracking grid
The Task Request record is created with taskStatus = In progress and a Team Access Add Approval Task definition (verify in DB or record view)
assertions: The newly created request shows status In progress
testCases.title: User submits a team access request

preconditions.state: A pending Team Access Add Approval request exists for a team the logged-in user manages (created by SCN-001 or seeded); User is logged in as a member of UAM managers

steps: Navigate to the Manager Tasks page
Open the pending access request by clicking its task-name start-process link
expectedResults: The manager's pending approval tasks are listed, each as a task-name link
The approval interface opens showing the requester, team, and application roles
The task closes and the user is granted the team/roles
The Task Request record's taskStatus = Approved and a UAM User Team row is created granting access
assertions: The request status is now Approved
testCases.title: Manager approves the pending request

plan.name: request-approval
plan.description: A user submits a request to join a team; the system routes it to the team's manager, who reviews and approves it on the Manager Tasks page. Verify the request is created with status In progress and becomes Approved after approval.
